comment: Same production sense; differs only in domain - METPO:2000202 inherits rdfs:domain METPO:1000525 (microbe) via METPO:2000001, whereas this term's subject is a trait causal node.
Same negated production sense; differs only in domain, as METPO:2007800 does from METPO:2000202.
Same electron-donation sense; differs only in domain.
Same electron-removal sense; differs only in domain.
Same efflux sense; differs only in domain.
Same uptake sense; differs only in domain.
Same carbon-source role. Not exactMatch: the subject is the trait rather than the organism, so the relation is stated from the disposition's side.
Same energy-source role; subject is the trait rather than the organism, and the range is wider (admits ENVIRONMENTAL_FACTOR such as light).
Same hydrolytic-cleavage sense; differs only in domain.
Same breakdown sense; differs only in domain, and the range additionally admits a cellular structure.
Same accumulation sense; differs only in domain.
